test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 14 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Rearrange the parts of the sentence in correct order.

P. contributed to the destruction of Sir Walter Raleigh’s “Lost Colony”

Q. a severe three-year drought in the late 16th century probably

R. at Roanoke Island in what is now North Carolina, and a subsequent

S. seven-year drought led to high mortality at the Jamestown Colony in Virginia
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 3' **i.e.** 'QPRS'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** The **correct arrangement** of the parts of the sentence is: **'QPRS'.**

 
• Q.</s
